data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.

scope.sampling_rule: All five explicitly numbered games in homepage 热门免费游戏; inspect each linked detail page. No arbitrary filler games added.

source_extensions.detail_navigation_note: Five unique linked details were inspected. Subway Surfers was revisited once because the first rendered read contained only the navigation/footer; the follow-up observation verified its visible 404 message.

limitations: Not a complete catalog or independently verified heat score.
Subway Surfers remained in the homepage numbered list but its detail page visibly returned 404; no detail metrics inferred.
Homepage numbered positions and detail popularity ranks disagree; preserved separately.
No online-number label was observed in this run; null means not observed, not zero, and previous online values were not carried forward.
Displayed likes/dislikes are rounded; votes are not plays, unique users, or concurrency.
Date labels retain month-level precision; no exact release date invented.
Changes between observations may reflect source display or cache differences. No growth or popularity velocity is inferred from this short interval.
Game frames may auto-load on detail visits; no gameplay inputs, voting, login, or hidden APIs used.
Previously downloaded cover files and generated concise descriptions are reused with their own original observation/fetch/generation timestamps; fresh metric timestamps do not imply refreshed media.
Cover visibility and download do not establish redistribution rights; rights remain with the respective owners.
